scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed a solid root cause analysis with an efficient approach: loading the binlog, searching errors, counting them, examining the project file, and synthesizing findings. It correctly identified the primary root cause (HotReload files compiled against net472 without framework conditions), listed the specific missing APIs, explained why they're unavailable, provided the fix pattern (already used elsewhere in the project), and identified the secondary issue. The main gap is not explicitly discussing cascade errors (FS0072) as downstream effects of the primary FS0039 errors. Overall this is a good analysis that would help a developer fix the build.

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
